snippet.title: Death Everywhere, So Save Paranoiacally 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on itch.io! ►►
https://bro-three.itch.io/dessp2
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You are not a hero, you are not a warrior... you're just a child.

Join Blue in this coming of rage story, where the forest doesn't just hate him—it wants him erased. Just a single mistake—a step in the wrong direction or a moment of weakness will cause instantaneous death.

Quite possibly the perfect game for your 'Bad Games Night' streams if you like yelling at the game for being cruel!

Remember to constantly save the game. Otherwise, you'll lose a lot of progress! You have been warned.
